how.spot.body: Kadeu, mokgeori jul, pyojipaneseo HelloSmile-eul chajaboseyo. Geuge inneun gosi baro Helloseupat-ieyo.

how.hello.body: Dagawaseo insahae juseyo. Helloseupat-eseoneun amudo dangsini beolsseo nugungareul algo isseul georago gidaehaji anayo.

about.title: Geullobeol peori tellebijeon
about.body-1: Geullobeol peori tellebijeon(GFTV)eun Singgaporeue bonsareul dun Asia choedaeui peori paendeom nyuseu chaeneorimnida.
about.body-2: Urineun oneulgwa naeirui modeun sarami gamsanghal su itdorok peori munhwaui seongjangeul sogaehago, saramdeuri seororeul algo ihaehal su inneun gongganeul mandeumnida.
about.body-3: Gohyangeseo chulbalhae yeoreo daeryuge geolchyeo hwaldonghaneun GFTV timeun gukjejeogigo damunhwajeogimyeo dagugeoreul gusahamnida.
